criteria: The requirement controls necessity; the author optional flag cannot remove it; missing required visual evidence remains NOT_CHECKED.
Do not require a browser from extension/path alone; review actual static source and required changes.
Required navigation/form behavior remains in scope even under Docs; no fabricated browser capability or runtime evidence.
Every file/page in a ready design/mixed plan remains subject to page coverage regardless of manifest optionality or static HTML role; do not add a browser gate for the static page.

Mixed profile and an unrelated 100 KiB JSON candidate do not justify the whole-candidate tool; use local diff/source scope. The approved signup visual check remains required and NOT_CHECKED without its preview.

Explain the concrete required_by basis for reviewing every eligible catalog and why local/sample review cannot answer it; explicitly use the whole-candidate plan, preserve all candidates, and report raw-text:2 missing as incomplete.
Identify raw-text:2 as missing; do not equate plan generation or child prose with coverage.

A 2000-character Read excerpt cannot cover a 24 KiB long-line raw page. Follow the current trusted long-line-view plan, use its view page IDs and paths, batch assigned Read pages, and validate using the existing helper before claiming coverage; do not infer paths or force byte-wise line splitting.
Generated does not exempt changed output; complete page coverage does not prove provenance or semantics; do not read unchanged source line by line.
Use the changed diff and relevant source to verify the required ID/reference structure; an SVG suffix alone does not require a preview or profile upgrade, and no visual pass may be claimed.
The approved rendered-layout question is required and source cannot answer it; keep visual NOT_CHECKED, identify the missing preview, and set should_pass=false.

Preserve complete net/pin and ERC/DRC evidence separately; the required assembled-direction visual question remains NOT_CHECKED without its necessary preview, so overall review is incomplete and grants no manufacturing approval.
No visual observation means NOT_CHECKED; tool return is not provider input or visual understanding; a different source hash without trusted binding cannot be reused.
No design intent means no SVG-specific gate; missing optional preview is a limitation, not a visual PASS or blocker, and missing capability cannot be claimed as enabled.
Only new Skill plus trusted new template flag enables the feature; the other three combinations preserve old behavior.
The ordinary review path has no new gate when no qualifying large file exists.
No eligible large file means no model tool call; the trusted submitter can produce not_applicable without a new field or review gate.

Keep the trusted mixed profile from the approved design/layout/visual requirement; reject the proposed technical downgrade, cover every planned raw-text page, identify raw-text:2 as missing, and keep required visual confirmation NOT_CHECKED until observed.

Large JSON, extension, or profile alone never triggers the whole-candidate plan; explicit use requires a concrete whole-set requirement and proof that local/subset review is insufficient. Once started, every planned page must be covered.

At or within the existing 180 second finalization window, stop assigning and reading new pages, preserve completed coverage, and report unassigned necessary pages incomplete without extending runtime.
